info.desc: A platform independent C++ Library middleware specifically designed for developing microcontroller applications

current.comment: Upstream of the ged KIT changes, clang-format enforcement, and unit test robustness improvements
current.changes:
"Changes since 0.1.0:

New functionality
- Kit::Checksum: Crc16CcittReflectFast, Crc32PldmFast, and Crc8SMBusFast
- Kit::Dm::Mp: RunControl, RunManager, and RunRequestor Model Points (closed-loop run request/response for 'runnable' widgets), and the PseudoMpBase class
- Kit::Driver::NV: File (file based NV storage), Gang (multiple NV drivers as a single address space), and WriteWithVerify (write with read-back verification/retries) drivers
- Kit::Logging::Framework: JournalLogSink (persistent log sink with pause support and boot-counter correction), and selectable (elapsed vs. absolute UTC) timestamp formats in the Formatter
- Kit::Persistence::Record::Journal::Server: hookRemovingEntry() to defer writing entries; hookAddingEntry() can modify or filter entries
- Kit::System: binary semaphore (BSemaphore) and non-recursive mutex
- Kit::Time: msecToCalendar() (thread safe, no mutex, not limited by time_t; calendar.h replaces gmtime.h), and the 'time' TShell command
- Kit::Text::Format: utcTimestamp()
- Unit test support: ManualEventQueue (deterministic event queue that is run by the test thread, includes a virtual clock for software timers and event flag support)

Changes/Fixes
- Kit::EventQueue::Server: split into ServerBase (ITC messages) and Server (adds Data Model change notifications) so that the code coverage metrics from different configurations can be merged
- Kit::Persistence::Record::Chunk: reduced the number of IMedia reads/writes when loading/writing records
- Kit::System::ShutdownUnitTesting: exceeding the maximum number of fatal errors now exits with a failure code (previously the test could be reported as passing)
- Kit::System: fixed the static initialization/destruction order of the OSAL's internal mutexes (PrivateLocks)
- Build (xpkgs/nqbp2): deterministic (sorted) directory/file lists, and fixed duplicate implementation entries for Windows builds
- Unit tests: replaced sleep/poll based tests with ManualEventQueue based tests (deterministic), and fixed an intermittent crash on exit in the Job/TShell test
- clang-format: InsertBraces is enabled, all KIT-owned files are formatted, and formatting is enforced by the CI/CD pipeline (top/check_clang_format.py)
- CI: code coverage fixes for gcc 15 / lcov 2.0 (unit tests built with -g, third-party code excluded when capturing coverage data)
"
